title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
summary: Monday.com becomes the latest tech company to attribute layoffs to AI adoption, joining at least 20 other major tech firms that have made similar announcements this year. The pattern reflects ongoing industry debates about whether automation concerns justify workforce reductions.
content: A running look — in reverse chronological order — at the bigger tech companies that have announced significant layoffs this year with AI as a stated factor.
